fact: MEYNG (founder Michel Wenezoui) says its SangoAI translation system for Sango, built by people rooted in Central Africa, is in production, using a frontier LLM with a 581-entry verified Sango vocabulary and native-speaker testing since launch.
Institut Pasteur de Bangui says its MEDICINE project will develop AI-based diagnostic aid tools for fever in under-fives, over four years from August 2024.

The MEYNG model card on Hugging Face describes an openly released Sango-French translation model fine-tuned from NLLB-200-distilled-600M on over 500,000 Sango-French sentence pairs, with benchmark results; the document does not say where it was built.
